summary: Centerra Gold filed a 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 press release announcing TSX acceptance of its renewed normal course issuer bid (Canada's equivalent of a US buyback program) and a new $75 million working capital credit facility for the Langeloth Metallurgical Facility. The NCIB permits repurchases of up to 19,318,076 common shares, 10% of public float, from November 10, 2026 to November 9, 2027, with daily purchases capped at 167,484 shares (25% of average daily volume) absent block exemptions. Prior bid bought 8,970,800 shares at a C$24.33 VWAP; OSC relief allows up to 10% of float via US venues.
